requirements.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the lighting and signalling devices shall continue to operate correctly.

requirements.text: Every vehicle bearing an approval mark as prescribed under this Regulation shall conform to the vehicle type approved, particularly as regards features which influence the behaviour of the parts of the structure and the components affected by impact.
requirements.quote: Every vehicle bearing an approval mark as prescribed under this Regulation shall conform to the vehicle type approved, particularly as regards features which influence the behaviour of the parts of the structure and the components affected by impact.

requirements.quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height at the test position which is greater than, or equal to, 425 mm and less than 500 mm the requirements of either paragraph 5.1.1. or 5.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.

requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with Annex 5, paragraph 2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN

requirements.quote: The selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: The tolerance to the direction of impact of the upper legform impactor shall be ±2°.

requirements.quote: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ±0.2 m/s.

requirements.quote: A minimum of nine tests shall be carried out with the child headform impactor over the areas prescribed by the child bonnet top test area and the child windscreen test area together, with three tests each to the middle and the outer thirds of the child/small adult test areas, at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: The external surface of the front bumper shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.
requirements.quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.

requirements.text: The external surface of the front bumper shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.
requirements.quote: The external surface of vehicles shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.

requirements.text: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The distance between two consecutive elements of grilles and gaps shall be determined according to the method described in paragraph 4. of Annex 3 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.
requirements.quote: The junction of the front with the side faces of each element forming a grille or gap shall be blunted.

requirements.text: The ends of the bumper shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.
requirements.quote: The ends of the bumpers shall be turned in towards the external surface in order to minimize the risk of fouling.

requirements.text: Where the bumper is recessed or integrated within the bodywork, the ends of the bumper shall be considered to satisfy the requirement that the ends be turned in towards the external surface.
requirements.quote: This requirement is considered to be satisfied if either the bumper is recessed or integrated within the bodywork

requirements.text: Where the end of the bumper is turned in, the end of the bumper shall not be contactable by a 100 mm sphere.
requirements.quote: or the end of the bumper is turned in so that it is not contactable by a 100 mm sphere

requirements.text: Where the end of the bumper is turned in, the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork shall not exceed 20 mm.
requirements.quote: and the gap between the bumper end and the surrounding bodywork does not exceed 20 mm.

requirements.text: When the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward.
requirements.quote: If the line of the bumper which corresponds to the outline contour of the car vertical projection is on a rigid surface, that surface shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm at all its points lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward

requirements.text: In all other cases, the bumper shall have a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm.
requirements.quote: and a minimum radius of curvature of 2.5 mm in all other cases.

requirements.text: The minimum radius of curvature of 5 mm shall apply to that part of the zone lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward which is situated between and in front (or rear in case of the rear bumper) of tangential points with the contour line of two vertical planes each forming with the longitudinal plane of symmetry of the vehicle an angle of 15 degrees.
requirements.quote: This provision applies to that part of the zone lying from the contour line to 20 mm inward which is situated between and in front (or rear in case of the rear bumper) of tangential points with the contour line of two vertical planes each forming with the longitudinal plane of symmetry of the vehicle an angle of 15°

requirements.text: The outward facing angles of parts on or of the bumper or of bumper insets which have a projection of less than 5 mm shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.
requirements.quote: but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

requirements.text: The bumper cover shall comply with the provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The provisions of paragraph 5. of this Regulation remain applicable.

requirements.text: The jacking brackets and exhaust pipe(s) shall not project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line lying vertically above them.
requirements.quote: The jacking brackets and exhaust pipe(s) shall not project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line lying vertically above them.

requirements.text: Where an exhaust pipe projects more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line, the exhaust pipe shall terminate in rounded edges, the minimum radius of curvature being 2.5 mm.
requirements.quote: As an exception to this requirement an exhaust pipe may project more than 10 mm beyond the vertical projection of the floor line, so long as it terminates in rounded edges, the minimum radius of curvature being 2.5 mm.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of less than 425 mm, the requirements of paragraph 4.1.1. shall be applied.
requirements.quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of less than 425 mm the requirements of paragraph 4.1.1. shall be applied.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height which is greater than, or equal to 425 mm and less than 500 mm, the requirements of either paragraph 4.1.1. or 4.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.
requirements.quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height which is greater than, or equal to 425 mm and less than 500 mm the requirements of either paragraph 4.1.1. or 4.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm, the requirements of paragraph 4.1.2. shall be applied.
requirements.quote: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm the requirements of paragraph 4.1.2. shall be applied.

requirements.text: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.1., the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1. shall be used.
requirements.quote: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.1., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.1. shall be used.

requirements.text: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.1., the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.1. shall be used.
requirements.quote: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.1., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.1. shall be used.

requirements.text: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.2., the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.2. shall be used.
requirements.quote: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.2., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.2. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.2. shall be used.

requirements.text: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.2., the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.2. shall be used.
requirements.quote: To verify compliance with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.2., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.2. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.2. shall be used.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm.
requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.
requirements.quote: the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.
requirements.quote: The absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.

requirements.text: Where the manufacturer nominates bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total, the absolute value of the tibia bending moment shall not exceed 380 Nm when tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper).
requirements.quote: In addition, the manufacturer may nominate bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total where the absolute value of the tibia bending moment shall not exceed 380 Nm.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN.
requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.
requirements.quote: the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.

requirements.text: When tested as a DPPS, the test conditions and requirements in Annex 1 shall apply.
requirements.quote: When tested as a DPPS, the test conditions and requirements in Annex 1 shall apply.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraphs 7.2., 7.3. and, if applicable, Annex 1, the HIC of the child headform shall comply with paragraph 5.2.3.
requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with paragraphs 7.2., 7.3. and, if applicable, Annex 1, the HIC shall comply with paragraph 5.2.3.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.2., 7.4. and, if applicable, Annex 1, the HIC of the adult headform shall comply with paragraph 5.2.3.
requirements.quote: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.2., 7.4. and, if applicable, Annex 1, the HIC shall comply with paragraph 5.2.3.

requirements.text: The HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over a minimum of one half of the child headform test area.
requirements.quote: The HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over a minimum of one half of the child headform test area

requirements.text: The HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over two thirds of the combined child and adult headform test areas.
requirements.quote: and 1,000 over two thirds of the combined child and adult headform test areas.

requirements.text: The HIC for the remaining areas shall not exceed 1,700 for both headforms.
requirements.quote: The HIC for the remaining areas shall not exceed 1,700 for both headforms.

requirements.text: In case there is only a child headform test area, the HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over two thirds of the test area.
requirements.quote: In case there is only a child headform test area, the HIC recorded shall not exceed 1,000 over two thirds of the test area.

requirements.text: In case there is only a child headform test area, the HIC for the remaining area shall not exceed 1,700.
requirements.quote: For the remaining area the HIC shall not exceed 1,700.

requirements.text: The manufacturer shall identify the zones of the bonnet top where the HIC must not exceed 1,000 (HIC1000 Zone) or 1,700 (HIC1700 Zone) (see Figure 11).
requirements.quote: The manufacturer shall identify the zones of the bonnet top where the HIC must not exceed 1,000 (HIC1000 Zone) or 1,700 (HIC1700 Zone) (see Figure 11).

requirements.text: The determination of the impacted zone shall be done by the first contact point of the head form with the "bonnet top".
requirements.quote: The determination of the impacted zone is done by the first contact point of the head form with the "bonnet top."

requirements.text: The devices designed to protect vulnerable road users shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.
requirements.quote: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.

requirements.text: The manufacturer shall show that any devices designed to protect vulnerable road users will act as intended in a pedestrian impact.
requirements.quote: It shall be the responsibility of the manufacturer to show that any devices will act as intended in a pedestrian impact.

requirements.text: Where vehicle components could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and have more than one fixed shape or position, the vehicle shall comply with the components in each fixed shape or position.
requirements.quote: For vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position shall require the vehicle to comply with the components in each fixed shape or position.

requirements.text: The child headform impactor shall be made of aluminium.
requirements.quote: The child headform impactor shall be made of aluminium, be of homogenous construction and be of spherical shape.

requirements.text: The child headform impactor shall be of homogenous construction.
requirements.quote: The child headform impactor shall be made of aluminium, be of homogenous construction and be of spherical shape.

requirements.text: The child headform impactor shall be of spherical shape.
requirements.quote: The child headform impactor shall be made of aluminium, be of homogenous construction and be of spherical shape.

requirements.text: The overall diameter of the child headform impactor shall be 165 ± 1 mm.
requirements.quote: The overall diameter shall be 165 ± 1 mm.

requirements.text: The mass of the child headform impactor shall be 3.5 ± 0.07 kg.
requirements.quote: The mass shall be 3.5 ± 0.07 kg.

requirements.text: The moment of inertia of the child headform impactor about an axis through the centre of gravity and perpendicular to the direction of impact shall be within the range of 0.008 to 0.012 kgm2.
requirements.quote: The moment of inertia about an axis through the centre of gravity and perpendicular to the direction of impact shall be within the range of 0.008 to 0.012 kgm2.

requirements.text: The centre of gravity of the child headform impactor including instrumentation shall be located in the geometric centre of the sphere with a tolerance of ± 2 mm.
requirements.quote: The centre of gravity of the headform impactor including instrumentation shall be located in the geometric centre of the sphere with a tolerance of ± 2 mm.

requirements.text: The sphere of the child headform impactor shall be covered with a 14 ± 0.5 mm thick synthetic skin.
requirements.quote: The sphere shall be covered with a 14 ± 0.5 mm thick synthetic skin, which shall cover at least half of the sphere.

requirements.text: The synthetic skin of the child headform impactor shall cover at least half of the sphere.
requirements.quote: The sphere shall be covered with a 14 ± 0.5 mm thick synthetic skin, which shall cover at least half of the sphere.

requirements.text: Each flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
requirements.quote: Each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.

requirements.text: The selected target points shall be in the bumper test area.
requirements.quote: The selected target points shall be in the bumper test area.

requirements.text: The direction of the impact velocity vector of the flexible lower legform impactor shall be in the horizontal plane.
requirements.quote: The direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The direction of the impact velocity vector of the flexible lower legform impactor shall be parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane of the flexible lower legform impactor shall be ± 2° at the time of first contact.
requirements.quote: The tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane shall be ± 2° at the time of first contact.

requirements.text: The axis of the flexible lower legform impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane.
requirements.quote: The axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane, with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ± 2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: The roll and pitch angle tolerance of the axis of the flexible lower legform impactor in the lateral and longitudinal plane shall be ± 2°.
requirements.quote: The axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane, with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ± 2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: The bottom of the flexible lower legform impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be 75 mm above the ground reference plane at the time of the first contact with the bumper, with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.
requirements.quote: The bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be 75 mm above the ground reference plane at the time of the first contact with the bumper (see Figure 21), with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.

requirements.text: When setting the height of the propulsion system, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor.
requirements.quote: When setting the height of the propulsion system, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor.

requirements.text: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in 'free flight' at the moment of impact.
requirements.quote: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in 'free flight' at the moment of impact.

requirements.text: The lower legform impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during the rebound of the impactor.
requirements.quote: The impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during the rebound of the impactor.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the flexible lower legform impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint.
requirements.quote: At the time of first contact the impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint, with a yaw angle tolerance of ± 5° (see Figure 20).

requirements.text: The yaw angle tolerance of the flexible lower legform impactor about its vertical axis at the time of first contact shall be ± 5°.
requirements.quote: At the time of first contact the impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint, with a yaw angle tolerance of ± 5° (see Figure 20).

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the centre line of the flexible lower legform impactor shall be within a ± 10 mm tolerance to the selected impact location.
requirements.quote: At the time of first contact the centre line of the impactor shall be within a ± 10 mm tolerance to the selected impact location.

requirements.text: During contact between the flexible lower legform impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground.
requirements.quote: During contact between the impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.

requirements.text: During contact between the flexible lower legform impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact any object which is not part of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: During contact between the impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the flexible lower legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.quote: The impact velocity of the impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: When the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact, the effect of gravity shall be taken into account.
requirements.quote: The effect of gravity shall be taken into account when the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact.

requirements.text: The tibia bending moments of the flexible lower legform impactor shall not exceed ± 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
requirements.quote: The tibia bending moments shall not exceed ± 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.

requirements.text: The offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test / acceleration phase.
requirements.quote: The offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test / acceleration phase.

requirements.text: Each upper legform to bumper test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
requirements.quote: Each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.

requirements.text: The selected target points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 3.10.
requirements.quote: The selected target points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 3.10.

requirements.text: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.
requirements.quote: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.

requirements.text: The tolerance to the direction of impact shall be ± 2°.
requirements.quote: The tolerance to this direction is ± 2°.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact, the upper legform impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a + 10 mm tolerance.
requirements.quote: At the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a + 10 mm tolerance

requirements.text: The upper legform impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.
requirements.quote: the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.

regulations.rationale: R42 governs the low-speed collision behaviour of the front protective device of M1 vehicles, which this front bumper is. (lexical: term match score 2.4)
Pedestrian safety for M1 vehicles requires the front bumper lower leg impact zone to meet legform and energy-absorption performance, so this product must fulfil it. (lexical: term match score 9.6)
External projections of M1 vehicles cover bodywork such as the bumper cover, so the bumper must limit injury risk from contact with its surface. (lexical: term match score 5.7)

Pedestrian safety GTR covers the lower legform and bumper impact zone of M1 vehicles, which this bumper's lower leg impact zone must meet in markets using GTR 9 rather than R127. (lexical: term match score 15.7)
Frontal collision regulation addresses occupant protection in the vehicle, and the bumper is only a contributing structure. (lexical: term match score 0.7)
Road illumination devices are not part of this bumper, though fog lamp housings could be integrated. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Front fog lamp requirements apply only if fog lamps are integrated, which the profile does not state. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
R48 governs lighting installation, and the lower grille does not carry lighting functions in the profile. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Retro-reflective device requirements apply only if reflectors are integrated in the bumper, which the profile does not state. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Retro-reflector requirements apply only if reflectors are integrated in the bumper, which the profile does not state. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Light-signalling device consolidation is not relevant because the bumper carries no lamps as a product function. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Retro-reflective markings apply to M2, M3, N and O2-O4 vehicles, not M1, and the bumper carries no such markings in the profile. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
Frontal occupant restraint systems are interior devices, not the bumper. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
AEBS for M1 vehicles covers sensors and braking functions, not the passive bumper structure. (lexical: term match score 0.0)
